// stats_process

simulator lang=spectre

parameters rsh=100 vth=450m tox=4n cg=1p
statistics {
    process {
        vary rsh dist=gauss std=5 percent=yes
        vary vth dist=unif N=20m
        vary tox dist=lnorm std=30m
        truncate tr=5
    }
    mismatch {
        vary vth dist=gauss std=5m
        vary cg dist=unif N=2 percent=yes
    }
    truncate tr=4
}

subckt cell (a b)
r1 (a b) resistor r=rsh*10
c1 (b 0) capacitor c=cg*2
v1 (b 0) vsource dc=vth
ends cell

subckt plain (a b)
r1 (a b) resistor r=1k
ends plain

x1 (in out) cell
x2 (out 0) plain
v0 (in 0) vsource dc=1

op1 dc
